description: Analyze one SmartUI comparison through a lens: consolidated (default), pixel, or dom. Returns the comparison data (mismatch %, verdict, correctly-labelled asset URLs) plus, for lens=dom, a real DOM byte delta when the artefact is served — no local filesystem needed. consolidated and pixel report upstream numbers and point at the assets; they do not run their own image analysis. lens=dom degrades to a structured error when DOM artefacts are not served. Read-only.

include_assets.description: urls (default) returns asset URLs only. inline additionally attaches the screenshots themselves as image blocks — compared only for lens=pixel, baseline+current+compared for consolidated, none for lens=dom. Use inline when you cannot fetch URLs.

lens.description: Analysis lens (default consolidated). layout and perceptual were retired — they returned the consolidated payload unchanged.

name: smartui_comparison_analyze
title: SmartUI Comparison Analyze
